subject: prd/worker-transcript-metrics
statement: When every process of a task has ended, the system shall record one task-level rollup aggregating those processes' figures, marking any figure whose parts are not all measured as incomplete rather than summing over what is present.
rationale: J1 and J3 are task-level questions; the operator ruled the rollup stored rather than derived *(#D-3, #D-7)*. A sum over an incomplete set is indistinguishable from a complete one, which would make the rollup the contract's one silently-wrong number
fit_criterion: for a multi-process task whose parts are all measured, exactly one rollup exists and each figure equals the sum of its parts; for a task where any part carries an FR-4 unavailability or lacks a record (UB-2), the corresponding rollup figure is marked incomplete and names the processes it could not include — never a sum presented as whole
